grader_prompt: You are evaluating whether a stackhawk-data-seed skill run produced correct, high-quality output. Review the agent's output text, the contents of data-seed/ (manifest.yaml, README.md, per-service step files, credentials.env.example), the .data-seed-credentials.env file, and the .gitignore. For each check below, determine pass/fail and write a one-sentence explanation. Return a JSON object conforming to rubric-schema.json.

checks.description: The discovery summary cites specific files, schemas, ports, or env vars actually found in the repo — not generic boilerplate. When something couldn't be determined, the skill asked the user rather than inventing a value.
checks.focus: Agent output during Phase 1 — concrete file paths and signals vs. invented details

checks.description: Phase 2 surfaced an explicit proposal listing the entities (1 user, 1 org, 1 resource) with the proposed default values and waited for the user to confirm or expand before emitting files.
checks.focus: Agent output for the Phase 2 proposal block and the pause for user confirmation

checks.description: data-seed/manifest.yaml has version, name, description, prerequisites, targets, steps, and outputs at the top level. Every step has id, type, file, target, and idempotency. No step is missing a required field.
Every depends_on entry in data-seed/manifest.yaml references an existing step id, and the dependency graph is acyclic.
Every steps[].file path in data-seed/manifest.yaml corresponds to an actual file that was emitted under data-seed/.
checks.focus: Cross-reference between manifest entries and emitted artifact files

checks.description: Each emitted SQL / HTTP / gRPC / Mongo / shell step uses a per-dialect idempotency idiom (ON CONFLICT, PUT, upsert, check-then-create) so re-running the manifest is safe. Any 'none: true' is intentional and called out in the manifest comment.

.data-seed-credentials.env exists, contains the values produced by the manifest (TEST_USER, TEST_PASS/TEST_PASSWORD, TEST_ORG_ID, TEST_APP_ID, plus any manifest outputs), and a matching data-seed/credentials.env.example is committed with the same keys but placeholder values.
.gitignore contains an entry that matches .data-seed-credentials.env (exact path or wildcard). The agent verified or added the entry before suggesting any git commit.
The agent did not create or modify stackhawk.yml. The handoff to hawkscan is via the credentials env file only.

The agent did not run docker-compose up, npm start, gradlew bootRun, or any other command that starts services. It only emitted artifacts and documented the prerequisite startup commands in data-seed/README.md.

Phases executed in order: Phase 0 (preflight) → Phase 1 (discover) → Phase 2 (propose + confirm) → Phase 3 (emit) → Phase 4 (handoff). No phase was skipped; Phase 3 did not start before Phase 2 confirmation.
checks.focus: Sequence of agent decisions and outputs

checks.description: The Phase 4 summary explicitly mentions that hawkscan is the next step and that it will read .data-seed-credentials.env automatically.
